name: s7-hello
description: Trial S7: a hello plugin in TypeScript, built with jco's QuickJS backend.

scripts.build: npm run check && node -e "require('node:fs').mkdirSync('dist', { recursive: true })" && jco componentize src/hello.ts --wit ../../../crates/plugin-host/trial/wit --world-name plugin --backend qjs --backend-qjs-disable-async --backend-qjs-stub-wasi --out dist/s7-hello.wasm
